name: pangram-ai-detector
title: Pangram AI Detector
description: Check selected or copied text for AI writing with Pangram.
author: mygirleatsmayo

commands.name: check-text
commands.title: Check Text
commands.description: Check the selected text, or the clipboard if nothing is selected, for AI writing.

commands.name: check-selected-text
commands.title: Check Selected Text
commands.description: Check the selected text for AI writing.

commands.name: check-clipboard-text
commands.title: Check Clipboard Text
commands.description: Check the clipboard text for AI writing.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Pangram API key. Create one at pangram.com/apikey.

preferences.name: versionInvalidatesCache
preferences.title: Cache
preferences.label: New Model Version invalidates cached results
preferences.description: Ignore results cached under an older Model Version.

preferences.name: literalSegmentText
preferences.title: Segments
preferences.label: Show Segment text literally
preferences.description: Show Segment text exactly as written, in a code block. Turn off to render Segment text as Markdown.

preferences.name: confirmAboveWords
preferences.title: Confirm Above (Words)
preferences.description: Ask before checking texts longer than this. Checks cost about $0.05 per 100 words. Default: 2000.

preferences.name: limitedConfidenceBelowWords
preferences.title: Limited Confidence Below (Words)
preferences.description: Flag results for shorter texts as limited confidence. Pangram doesn't publish its cutoff; 200 is an estimate based on observed website behavior. Default: 200.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: How long to wait for Pangram before giving up. Default: 300.
